svg.title: Binary search convergence for upper_bound
svg.desc: Finding the leftmost index whose value is greater than the target, 2, in the array 1, 2, 2, 2, 4, 7. The search keeps narrowing toward the right whenever the middle value is still at or below the target.
svg.text: low = 0, high = 6, mid = 3 → value 2 is at most target, search right half
low = 4, high = 6, mid = 5 → value 7 is greater than target, search left half
low = 4, high = 5, mid = 4 → value 4 is greater than target, search left half
low = high = 4 → upper_bound = 4, the first index with a value > target
